_doc: The Corvane Field Lab (agent Y): the tier-5 Bloom lab compound random worlds place far from the start. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_lab.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_lab.py; materials game/data/materials/props_lab.json; the lab_signs lettering atlas textures/gen/lab.py. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Shells (lab_*_shell) wrap the POI's kit rooms: origin at the rooms' plan centre on the ground (place them y = -floor_height); the catalog's SHELLS lists the rooms and openings they are cut for. Wall props hang with their origin on the wall plane; ceiling props hang from it.

defs.name: Prefab Lab Module
defs.description: A prefab lab module on concrete piers round a 9 x 4 m kit room: ribbed white panels, a steel skid and skirting, a low-pitched roof with its rooftop air unit, a vent stack and the module number stencilled at the door end (shell: origin at the room's plan centre on the ground, place it y = -floor_height; turned 180 degrees for modules east of the boardwalk).

defs.name: Decontamination Unit
defs.description: The Cordon's decontamination unit round its 6 x 4 m kit rooms (PPE, shower, airlock): ribbed panels in Cordon grey, a hazard band, the DECON stencil, a water tank and pump on the roof, its back against the containment block (no north wall; shell: origin at the rooms' plan centre on the ground, y = -floor_height).

defs.name: Covered Boardwalk
defs.description: Four metres of the covered boardwalk: steel posts, a corrugated roof on purlins with a gutter, the conduit and a caged lamp under it (no collision: the boardwalk is the kit floor under it).

defs.name: Earth Bank
defs.description: The hillside the containment block is dug into: a bank of earth, rock and roots three metres high against the wall, grass on its crown (its high side at the back, -Z).

defs.name: Station Fence
defs.description: Three metres of the station's security fence: galvanized posts set in concrete, chain-link, three strands of barbed wire on Y-arms and a concertina coil between them (+Z is inside; destroyed: the mesh torn, the coil sagging).

defs.name: Cut Fence
defs.description: A bay of the station fence cut through with bolt cutters and peeled back both ways, the concertina snipped and hanging (no collision: the way in).

defs.name: Station Gate
defs.description: The station's double gate on heavy posts, chained and padlocked in the middle, the Corvane plate on one leaf and the Cordon's biohazard notice on the other.

defs.name: Station Sign
defs.description: CORVANE MINING CO. - FIELD STATION 2 - EXPLORATION DIVISION on a painted steel board between two posts, the Cordon's BIOHAZARD notice zip-tied over its corner.

defs.name: Biohazard Plate
defs.description: A BIOHAZARD - CORDON MEDICAL AUTHORITY - NO ENTRY plate wired to the fence at chest height.

defs.name: Diesel Tank
defs.description: A double-walled diesel tank on steel saddles inside a bund: placards, a level gauge, the fill box and a hose reel.

defs.name: Station Generator
defs.description: A skid-mounted diesel generator in a sound-proofed enclosure: louvres, the exhaust stack and its rain cap, the control panel with its hour meter, cables run out under the skid (lit: its panel lamp).

defs.name: Core Drill Rig
defs.description: A skid-mounted diamond core drill parked in the yard: the mast laid back on its stand, the rod rack, the power pack, the water tank and a stack of empty core trays.

defs.name: Core Racking
defs.description: Steel pallet racking stacked with waxed core boxes end-on, their ends stencilled with hole and depth (BH-7 among them); a few pulled out, lids off (destroyed: a shelf collapsed and the boxes spilled).

defs.name: Core Boxes
defs.description: Waxed cardboard core boxes stacked on a pallet, the top one open on its rows of grey drill core, a depth block between the runs.

defs.name: Core Saw
defs.description: A diamond core saw on a steel stand: the blade guard, a sliding cradle with a half-cut core, the water tray and pump, the motor and a spattered splash board.

defs.name: Logging Bench
defs.description: A geologist's logging bench of heavy timber: an angled tray of core under a lamp, a hand lens, a scale bar, a clipboard of logging sheets and a mug of pencils.

defs.name: Lab Bench
defs.description: A lab bench with a black epoxy top over steel cabinets, a reagent shelf of brown and clear bottles above, a gas tap and a socket strip (destroyed: the shelf down, the bottles broken across the top).

defs.name: Fume Hood
defs.description: A fume hood on its cabinet base: the sash glass half raised, the baffle, a flow gauge and the duct rising to the ceiling.

defs.name: Biosafety Cabinet
defs.description: A class II biosafety cabinet on its stand: the angled sash, the front grille, the blower housing on top, a UV tube and the airflow alarm panel.

defs.name: Minus-80 Freezer
defs.description: An upright ultra-low freezer: frost round its door seal, the keypad and temperature display, warning labels, the compressor grille at its foot.

defs.name: Centrifuge
defs.description: A floor-standing refrigerated centrifuge: the lid, the control panel and its lock lamp.

defs.name: Microscope
defs.description: A binocular microscope with a slide on its stage and a box of slides beside it (tabletop: place it on a bench with y).

defs.name: Sample Shelving
defs.description: Wire shelving of sample bottles, tube racks, labelled boxes and a clipboard.

defs.name: Nitrogen Dewar
defs.description: A liquid-nitrogen dewar on a wheeled base, frost on its neck, a cryo-glove over the handle.

defs.name: Specimen Store
defs.description: A stainless cryo cabinet behind a padlocked grille: sealed sample canisters in numbered rows, frost on the shelves.

defs.name: Vault Collar
defs.description: The specimen vault's steel collar round its door: the locking wheel, the bolt housings, the keypad and the hazard stripes (the vault door is the kit door_vault).

defs.name: Card Reader
defs.description: A keycard reader beside the airlock door: a slot, a keypad and a red lamp (lit: the lamp burns on the battery).

defs.name: Decon Shower
defs.description: A decontamination shower: a stainless tray and drain grate, a ring of nozzles overhead and nozzle bars on the sides, a pull handle, an eyewash and a torn curtain.

defs.name: PPE Rack
defs.description: A rack of hanging Tyvek suits and respirators, boots and taped gloves below, a box of filters on top.

defs.name: Biohazard Bin
defs.description: A red pedal bin with the biohazard trefoil, a yellow bag pulled over its rim.

defs.name: Radio Desk
defs.description: The station's radio desk: an HF transceiver and its power supply, a desk mic, a handset, the frequency card, a map of the claims under the glass and the logbook.

defs.name: Data Rack
defs.description: A 19-inch rack cabinet: tape drives and servers, a patch panel and a bundle of cable out of its roof (lit: its status lights on the battery).

defs.name: Lab Panel Light
defs.description: A recessed fluorescent panel on the generator circuit.

defs.name: Emergency Beacon
defs.description: A red emergency beacon on its battery pack over a door.

defs.name: Biohazard Sign
defs.description: A BIOHAZARD - CONTAINMENT LEVEL 3 sign. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Airlock Stencil
defs.description: AIRLOCK - ONE DOOR AT A TIME stencilled on a steel plate. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Decon Board
defs.description: The decon line in three steps: 1 PPE, 2 DECON SHOWER, 3 AIRLOCK. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Vault Plate
defs.description: SPECIMEN VAULT - CORDON MEDICAL AUTHORITY - TWO-PERSON RULE. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Emergency Exit Sign
defs.description: EMERGENCY EXIT with an arrow up the shaft. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Containment Notice
defs.description: CONTAINMENT - AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY - BY ORDER. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Core Shed Board
defs.description: CORE SHED - NO SMOKING painted on a board. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Module Plate: Prep
defs.description: LAB 1 - SAMPLE PREP on the module's door end. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Module Plate: Microscopy
defs.description: LAB 2 - MICROSCOPY on the module's door end. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Module Plate: Cold Room
defs.description: LAB 3 - COLD ROOM -80 on the module's door end. (wall-mounted)

defs.name: Module Plate: Admin
defs.description: ADMIN - RADIO on the module's door end. (wall-mounted)
